paragraphs.text: Gilberto Tinoco Arzate participated in Shipment LZC-10-03 on 2010-04-04. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Shipment LZC-10-03 on 2010-04-04. Shipment LZC-10-03 occurred at Lázaro Cárdenas on 2010-04-04. A bar owner in Lázaro Cárdenas with regular contact among port workers reported that Tinoco, the network's logistics figure known as El Grúa, moved 400 kg of methamphetamine precursor out of the port in a container that had been relabeled as agricultural supplies. The load was said to be bound for a distribution point near Los Angeles.

Gilberto Tinoco Arzate used DEMO-ACCT-00130 on 2010-04-04. Shipment LZC-10-03 transited Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza on 2010-04-04. Bruma del Cobre controlled Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza from 2010-03-14 until 2012-07-09. The source stated that Tinoco settled the yard fees for the container through the account identified above and that the same account had been mentioned by port workers in connection with earlier payments. The source characterized the Lázaro Cárdenas docks as fully under the network's control at this time, with no competing crew able to move containers without permission.

Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Gilberto Tinoco Arzate was a member of Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2027-01-01. The source described Tinoco as one of the original members of the network and as answerable only to Anzures. The reporting office assesses the source as having good access to dock gossip but no direct observation of the load. The quantity reported here is the source's estimate and has not been weighed by the reporting office.
